method_note: BAYESIAN-FUSED flow: each evidence channel is a noisy observation z~N(flow,1/tau); fused flow = precision-weighted posterior mean, confidence = P(sign correct). Channels: measured anchors (GLD tonnage, COT positioning, on-chain stablecoin supply), dark-pool DIX order-flow, volume (Chaikin Money Flow), price residual. Measured anchors DECAY in precision with staleness (tau_eff=tau0*0.5^(age/hl); daily flows hl~1.5d, weekly COT hl~4d) so a held flow fades and fresh channels catch reversals. Risk-off context (VIX/GPR/DXY) was validated NULL for direction so it no longer tilts the flow arrow; it drives violence_fwd (EXPECTED next-period violence). DESCRIPTIVE, not a forecast.
